description: Appraise how rare a Solana address is: its detected vanity pattern, rarity score, rarity bits, tier, and expected grind attempts. Pure math on the Base58 address — nothing is stored. If the address has been published to the proof-of-grind gallery, the public entry is returned too. Read-only, no payment.

address.description: The Base58 Solana public key to appraise (32–44 chars).

prefixLen.description: Override how many leading characters to treat as the pattern prefix.

suffixLen.description: Override how many trailing characters to treat as the pattern suffix.

name: vanity_appraise
title: Appraise the rarity of a Solana address
